title: Zift
creator: Javor Gardev
description: A stylish black-and-white noir about a man released from prison into 1960s Sofia, now a communist city he barely recognizes, who goes looking for a hidden diamond. In Bulgarian.

title: Eastern Plays
creator: Kamen Kalev
description: A recovering addict and woodcarver in Sofia sees a group of neo-Nazis, his younger brother among them, beat a Turkish family. Its lead, Christo Christov, was playing a version of himself and died before the premiere. In Bulgarian.

title: The Boy Who Was a King
creator: Andrey Paounov
description: A documentary on Simeon II, who became tsar at six in 1943, was sent into exile by the communists, and came back to be elected prime minister in 2001. Vrana Palace was his childhood home.

title: Directions
creator: Stephan Komandarev
description: One night in Sofia seen through the windows of six taxis and their drivers, many of them educated people squeezed by debt and corruption. In Bulgarian.

title: Women Do Cry
creator: Mina Mileva & Vesela Kazakova
description: A family of women in Sofia during one hot summer, after one of them learns she has HIV, set against the country’s angry debate over a European treaty on violence against women. With Maria Bakalova. In Bulgarian.

title: Blaga’s Lessons
creator: Stephan Komandarev
description: A retired teacher in Sofia loses her savings to phone scammers, then takes a job working for them. Winner of the top prize at the Karlovy Vary film festival. In Bulgarian.
